objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Deploy a project of your own to the open Scrapyd API, run code on the server and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The Scrapyd API accepts projects from anyone. Read the Scrapyd documentation for the endpoint that adds a version.
Scrapyd imports the project to list its spiders, which runs its code. The flag is at /ctf/flag.

steps.title: Check authentication
steps.prompt: Does the API ask for credentials? (yes or no)

steps.title: Name the format
steps.prompt: In which packaging format is the project uploaded? (one word)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which weakness class is this? (two words)
